svg.title: The cinematic tour — the camera flies through your hubs
svg.desc: The graph lens during a guided tour: a dotted camera path links numbered stops at the hub notes, the current stop is framed with a label card, and a Stop tour button and a 'tour' status are shown.
svg.text: Any drag, wheel, click or key hands the camera back to you
